question: According to the census of India 2011, which state has the lowest population growth rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Nagaland** experienced the lowest population **-0.58%** growth rate among Indian states.
 
• Nagaland is the only state in India that has recorded a **Negative population growth** as per the 2011 census.
 
• It shows that Nagaland recorded Negative Growth in Population Minus 0.47% Decadal Population Growth.
 
• As per the census 2001, **19,88,602 (total population) **now that has declined to 19,80,602 (census 2011).
 
• It is bordered by the state of **Assam to the West, Manipur to the South, Arunachal Pradesh to the North**, and the Sagaing Region of Myanmar to the East.** Kohima is the capital** of Nagaland state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Population growth rate of **Jharkhand** was **22.42%** over the decade 2001-2011.
 
• The Population growth rate of **Punjab** was **13.89%** over the decade 2001-2011.
 
• The Population growth rate of **Uttar** **Pradesh** was **20.09%** over the decade 2001-2011.
